purpose: Operator decision packet for the seven numeric thresholds required before EDGE_PROVISIONAL_PAPER_PASS can ever be emitted.

thresholds.name: min_sample_count
thresholds.rationale: Edge proof should survive enough independent paper/shadow replay bundles to reduce luck, symbol clustering, and short-window market regime bias.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_loose: A few favorable samples can overfit to one volatility regime and create a false edge claim.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_strict: Proof may be delayed even when a real edge exists, especially if high-quality paper signals are sparse.

thresholds.name: min_after_cost_expectancy_bps
thresholds.rationale: The mean realized after-cost return must clear fees, slippage, latency noise, and paper/live drift with positive margin.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_loose: Marginal edge can disappear under real fills or small cost-model error.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_strict: The evaluator may reject viable low-turnover or lower-volatility strategies.

thresholds.name: min_after_cost_lower_ci_bps
thresholds.rationale: The bootstrap lower confidence bound should remain non-negative, preferably positive, so the edge is not only a point-estimate artifact.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_loose: A positive average with a negative uncertainty band can be misread as proven edge.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_strict: A noisy but improving model may remain blocked until substantially more samples accumulate.

thresholds.name: max_drawdown_bps_rolling
thresholds.rationale: Paper edge must not depend on tolerating deep rolling adverse excursions. Drawdown is a hard risk-control threshold, not an informational metric.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_loose: A positive expectancy can hide unacceptable tail loss and liquidation exposure.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_strict: Normal intraday volatility may block otherwise controlled strategies.

thresholds.name: min_downside_pre_cascade_recall
thresholds.rationale: The system must catch most downside pre-cascade events before scaling; missing these events is worse than over-blocking.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_loose: V2 can pass while still missing large downside events.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_strict: The system may overfit to rare shock labels or block progress when there are too few cascade examples.

thresholds.name: max_false_positive_rate
thresholds.rationale: Accepted trades must not be wrong too often after costs, or turnover and fee drag will dominate.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_loose: The evaluator can pass a strategy that takes too many bad trades.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_strict: It can reject a strategy with acceptable expectancy but moderate noise.

thresholds.name: max_false_negative_rate
thresholds.rationale: V2 should not miss too many profitable paper/shadow opportunities, because excessive false negatives can prove the gate is over-blocking edge.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_loose: V2 can appear safe by refusing trades while failing to capture valid opportunities.
thresholds.risk_of_setting_too_strict: The operator may force the model toward over-trading to avoid missed opportunities.
